verses.text: O LORD|strong="H3068" , rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
Have mercy upon me, O LORD|strong="H3068" ; for I am* weak: O LORD|strong="H3068" , heal me; for my bones are vexed.
My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD|strong="H3068" , how long?
Return, O LORD|strong="H3068" , deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies’ sake.
For in death there is* no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?
I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.
Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD|strong="H3068" hath heard the voice of my weeping.
The LORD|strong="H3068" hath heard my supplication; the LORD|strong="H3068" will receive my prayer.
Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and* be ashamed suddenly.
